providers.name: privatemodeai
providers.note: Privacy-first via confidential computing (AMD SEV-SNP + NVIDIA CC). REQUIRES local proxy binary — auto-starts when PRIVATEMODEAI_API_KEY is set (adds ~15-30s boot for remote attestation). Hardware-enforced E2E encryption: Edgeless Systems, Scaleway, model vendors cannot see prompts. Free: 5M initial tokens, then 1M prompt + 1M completion/mo. Models (chat): kimi-k2.6 (256K ctx, vision, tool calls, multiplier 1x), gemma-4-31b (256K ctx, vision, tool calls, multiplier 1x), gpt-oss-120b (128K ctx, tool calls, multiplier 2x). Qwen3-Embedding 4B and speech models exist but are excluded from sync (chat completions only).
